evidence: Plan AC: "`src/rebar/llm/eval_specs/code-review-failover.yaml` includes a fixture..."

findings.finding: The AC names the eval spec `src/rebar/llm/eval_specs/code-review-failover.yaml`, but the eval-spec loader/discovery requires the `.eval.yaml` suffix (`eval.py` resolves `eval_specs/<prompt_id>.eval.yaml`; `provider_parity.py` globs `*.eval.yaml`), and every existing spec in that directory (e.g. `code-review-concurrency.eval.yaml`, `code-review-performance.eval.yaml`) uses it.
